verdict.rationale: BVNK documents general wallet creation via API/Portal and Hawk authentication for account-level API access, but there is no evidence of agent-specific scoped keys, programmatic sub-wallet issuance for autonomous agents, or policy/spend-limit controls restricting what an agent can move. The one reference to an 'agent-wallet-cli' repo (bvnk-probe-2) is just a bare link with no documented content on scoping or limits.
